pb-books-posting.heading: Post to client books
pb-books-posting.boundary: Review the exact draft first. Issuing is a separate approval. No email is sent.
pb-books-posting.demo: Demo only: no provider access. Do not enter a real token. Preparing a draft stops when the books cannot be read.
pb-books-posting.session: The token stays only in the open session. The input clears after submission or changing client.
pb-books-posting.mappingHelp: Copy item and tax IDs from this client account. Ask the bookkeeper to confirm the tax treatment.
pb-books-posting.supported: Supports one aggregate unit per non-inventory item. Shipping, unsupported taxes and incomplete provider evidence need the manual path.
pb-books-posting.aggregate: Each line is an aggregate amount with quantity one, not an inventory quantity.
pb-books-posting.unknown: The document may exist. Check the client books manually. Chausar will not retry it.
pb-books-posting.stopped: This run stopped. Inspect its recorded outcome before starting another dry run.
pb-books-posting.issueHelp: Issue only this reviewed draft. This does not email it.
pb-books-posting.tally: Tally writes are planned until this desktop installation and its real optional-voucher capture are qualified. Use manual entry meanwhile.
pb-books-posting.tallyIssue: To issue a reviewed optional voucher in Tally, use Ctrl+L to make it Regular, then save. Automatic conversion is not qualified.
pb-books-posting.reason.already-posted: Already present in the client books
pb-books-posting.reason.paid-unposted-or: Paid order has no existing document
pb-books-posting.error.REQUEST_FAILED: Could not read this work. Try opening it again.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_READ_FAILED: The client books could not be read completely. Nothing was proposed or written. Use manual review meanwhile.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_CONNECTION_: Connect this client account for the current session.
Check the account region, company and mapping fields.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_MAPPING_UNS: This mapping or provider evidence is unsupported. Use the manual path.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_CONSENT_REQ: Confirm the client consent on this order first.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_SOURCE_CHAN: The source changed or was removed. Prepare a fresh dry run.
pb-books-posting.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The request, account or document changed. Read it again before approving.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_STILL_RUNNI: This action is still claimed. Wait for its recorded outcome.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_NOT_INTERRU: This work does not need interruption recovery.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_ALREADY_SEN: This document was sent or needs an outcome check. Do not send it again.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_INPUT_INVAL: Check the source CSV against the posting template.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_CYCLE_INVAL: Choose this client and its correct accounting period.
pb-books-posting.error.BOOKS_WORK_NOT_FO: This dry run was removed. Open the current client cycle.
